title: MysqlChallangeBridge
description: MysqlChallangeBridge watches the RandomChallenge player data files (plugins/RandomChallenge/Player Data) and automatically syncs changes to a MySQL database.
body:
![MysqlChallangeBridge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/daabbb241f54a20f40732d5e8272b3d2cabc399b.png)

MysqlChallangeBridge is a small bridge plugin that reads RandomChallenge player data files (plugins/RandomChallenge/Player Data) and keeps them synced to a MySQL table in near‑real time.

It only writes when a file changes and all settings (path, interval, DB credentials, table name) live in config.yml, so nothing is hard‑coded. 

Built for Spigot/Paper/Purpur 1.20.x

Requires RandomChallenge: https://modrinth.com/plugin/randomchallange
